must_include_phrases: This work aims at giving an updated picture of the strict interaction between main plant biologically active compounds and botanicals.
Botanicals are made of single herbs or by mixing different herbs, from raw material of whole plants or parts of them
herbal medicines include herbs, herbal materials, herbal preparations and finished herbal products
The need for categorization of botanicals as well as for the implementation of specific and dedicated databases
